caveats: the validation split does double duty: 03 uses it for alpha selection / early stopping and 04 uses it for conformal calibration, so the 1-alpha coverage guarantee is approximate, not exact
DAVIS labels are censored: 69.6% of pKd values sit on the 10000 nM ceiling, so residual distributions are mixtures and constant-width intervals over-cover the ceiling block
under the temporal protocol the calibration set precedes the test set in time, which is exactly where exchangeability fails; coverage there is a measurement, not a guarantee
